stageA.sourceWarmup: What do you know about bar graphs? Quiet thinking, real partner discussion, collective record.
stageA.sourceActivity1: Pairs create their OWN survey question with 3 or 4 response categories; actually collect classmates' responses, make an original labeled picture or bar graph with a title and key/equal numbered scale.
stageA.sourceActivity2: Groups of four EXCHANGE genuine graphs, students author questions about combining categories or how many more/less, exchange questions and answer with arithmetic equations.
stageA.sourceActivity3: Pairs use two real facts from their survey to create an accurately labeled tape diagram and corresponding compare equation, discuss teacher review.
stageA.sourceLessonSynthesis: Compare the original picture/bar graph to a tape diagram for SAME surveyed students: full display vs exact two-category comparison. Modelling skill MP4.
stageA.sourceCoolDown: None accessible in public source; independent Edulytics cool-down must not be falsely attributed to publisher.
stageA.rights: Source educational maths content and activities reviewed; first-party diagrams must be original; protected Student Response/photocopier templates not asserted.
stageA.factualLimits: No authenticated physical classroom survey or publisher's restricted responses observed. No student PII should be stored in publicly visible activity.

stageB.repair: Replaces generic graph-reading instructions with original optional student-authored real survey and 3–4 categories, picture OR bar graphs, genuine peer questioning, two-category tape diagram and source-correct separation of fictional models.
